name: City Horizon Classic Tycoon Carousel Art Library
purpose: Use persistent modular artwork with classic tycoon readability and material discipline, authored for CH_CAMERA_V1 and reviewed at gameplay scale.

materialIntent.base: painted wood + brass trim + localized contact shadow
materialIntent.platform: painted wood top + decorative fascia + three-tone depth
materialIntent.canopy: cloth panels + ribs + dark underside + scalloped hem
materialIntent.horse: painted carousel figure + saddle + harness + readable four-direction anatomy

rule: A production carousel frame must use persistent modular artwork authored for CH_CAMERA_V1. Build success alone does not approve visual quality.
